_doc: The one market calendar: the producer's own trading days (cli/builders via calendar.load_trading_calendar) and the market_calendar dataset the desktop app syncs are both read from this file. Curated by hand from exchange circulars, never scraped; refresh yearly (RUNBOOK 'Yearly').

Per venue (NSE, BSE, MCX; the app's NFO shares NSE): source = the circulars behind it; closures = closed dates by year; sessions = days that trade other hours than the regular ones (a special session on a weekend or a closure, or a partial day), exchange-local HH:MM with an optional preOpen (call auction start) and a source when it differs from the venue's; coveredYears = years whose closures are verified complete with every special session listed (the app reads any other year as unknown; a listed session still awaiting its hours is treated as closed until they are added).
A session without hours is a day the exchange is known to have traded whose hours are not yet verified: the producer counts it as a trading day; the app is not sent it until its hours are added.

NSE.source: NSE Capital Market trading-holiday circulars: 2025 CMTR65587; 2026 CMTR71775, amended by CMTR72260 (2026-01-15); 2021-2024 verified against NSE's archive (a bhavcopy present or absent for every day, 2026-10-25), special-session hours from the cited circulars
